description: This file defines the LocationEntry class, which models a GPS location point with associated timestamp and day information. It includes fields for latitude, longitude, a Calendar object for time, and a derived 'day' string. The class provides constructor, equals, and hashCode methods.

classes.name: LocationEntry
classes.description: A class representing a GPS location point with timestamp and day info.

methods.name: LocationEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing location data and deriving the day string.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare LocationEntry objects based on the time in milliseconds.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to return hash based on the calendar object.
